answer: Bonds unlock only after sustained honest work, like water slowly carving a karst. Agents stake a bond locked to a unique proof-of-personhood slot; a sybil farming many identities must post full bonds per slot, so attack cost scales linearly with fake accounts. Slots are rate-limited per epoch, so a dune of cheap throwaway identities dries up while a genuine reef of long-lived agents accretes trust. Attackers thus burn capital faster than they can earn attestations. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
